comment: Pinned build inputs. scripts/fetch-sources.ts downloads each into .cache/ (gitignored) and fails if a checksum changes. Never edit Quran text: if Tanzil publishes a new version, investigate the diff, then update the pin and log it in DECISIONS.md.

sources.what: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani, Version 1.1). Options: quranType=uthmani, outType=txt-2 ('Text (with aya numbers)'), marks=true (pause marks), sajdah=true (sajdah signs). Not sent: rub (rub-el-hizb), laa, stanween (sequential tanween, me_quran only) — Tanzil treats ANY value, even 'false', as ON, so these must be omitted.
sources.licence: Tanzil terms: verbatim copies only; credit Tanzil Project; link to tanzil.net. File header states CC BY 3.0.

sources.what: Same Tanzil Uthmani v1.1 text with no pause marks / sajdah signs (all optional marks omitted). Used ONLY as classifier input: the cpfair decision trees were built on text without pause marks. Verified at build time to be an exact subsequence of the shipped file.
The Tanzil text copy cpfair/quran-tajweed's shipped 2017 annotations refer to (downloaded ca. 6 Apr 2017, per its README). Used only to transfer the original 2017 annotations for comparison.
Tanzil Quran metadata (surah names, juz/hizb/page/sajda partitions).
sources.licence: File declares license="cc-by", (C) 2008-2009 Tanzil.info. Credit + link to tanzil.net.

sources.what: English translation by Ali Quli Qarai (Tanzil, last update 11 Apr 2022). Not committed (conservative): fetched at build time and added to the site only.
sources.licence: Tanzil translations: non-commercial use only; link back to tanzil.net/trans if more than three are used.

sources.what: English translation by Mohammad Habib Shakir (Tanzil, last update 22 Jun 2010). Not committed: build-time only.
cpfair/quran-align release data (word timings). Only the two Minshawi files are extracted.
cpfair/quran-tajweed (decision trees + classifier). Run on the shipped text to REBUILD annotations.
sources.licence: Data CC BY 4.0 (Collin Fair). Code: no licence file in the repo — run at build time only, never copied into this repo.
